  "reasoning": "The model generated conversational text instead of invoking the book_room tool. The evaluation failed during AST decoding, indicating the model output was not properly structured as a tool call.",
  "error_identification": "The model did not attempt to call book_room at all; instead it returned only natural language asking for clarification. The decoder expected a tool call structure but received a plain string response, causing the 'str' object has no attribute 'keys' error.",
  "root_cause_analysis": "The model treated the booking request as requiring additional user input before tool invocation, rather than recognizing that sufficient parameters (hotel name, room count, duration) were provided to make an initial book_room call. }

Guidance:
- If the evaluation PASSED, many cases you would return an empty operation list. Propose removals or updates when the current playbook conflicts with the verified behaviour as to need to be updated.

- Keep updates scoped to the triggering context unless the pattern is clearly systemic.
- Keep content under 160 characters. Return an empty list when no update is needed.
